**Finding: COMPLIANT (preferred position met) — no redline proposed.**

- **What I checked:** Targeted searches for "minimum", "purchase", "commit", "supply", "volume/forecast/quantity", "requirements", "shortfall/take-or-pay", and the Article 6 payment provisions.
- **Results:** The only "minimum" hits are the Article 11.6 insurance limits (coverage floors, not purchase obligations). Section 4.5.1 gives AbbVie the *sole right* — not an obligation — to Manufacture or have Manufactured and supply commercial product, so there is no obligation to source volumes from Harpoon. Article 6 milestones and royalties are licence consideration on actual Net Sales (Section 6.5.1), with the obligation expressly ceasing at Royalty Term expiry (Section 6.5.2); per the rule's boundary, these are not volume commitments and are not re-flagged here.
- **Conclusion:** AbbVie bears no minimum purchase or volume commitment and pays only against actual sales/achieved milestones, meeting the preferred MINCOMMIT position. No fallback true-up or reduction mechanic is needed, and adding one would only introduce a commitment concept that does not currently bind us.
